notes.title: 🚅 Walking Speed Increase!
notes.content:
[h3]--- 🚨 [b]MAJOR NEWS[/b] 📰 ---[/h3]

Everyone was waiting for this moment and finally, we have increased the WALKING SPEED! 🏃🏻‍♀️💨

[b][u]Before:[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/b4a936aecc96ff217341b969ecfa51d162932207.gif[/img]

[b][u]After:[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/41b2c4e335a40aaaddaf5f217d4485d0cda023ce.gif[/img]

We have also fixed a bug that prevents you to exit when examining an item. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519313/967dd9f041a28580dc215452be9ce76be51ebd7e.gif[/img]

Hope to see you soon!
Thank you for your feedback! 🤓
